newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Jacky Maeder sells service to Swiss post.
newsitem.headline: Jacky Maeder sells service to Swiss post.

text.p: Jacky Maeder, a freight forwarding unit of SAirGroup, has sold a distribution system in the retail trade for packages from five to 30 kilos to state-owned Swiss postal authorities, Die Post.
Die Post said in a statement the sale was part of closer strategic cooperation among itself and Jacky Maeder, part of SAirGroup's SAirLogistics divisions.
The sale, for an undisclosed amount, takes effect on September 1.
Jacky Maeder founded the distribution system, called City, in 1991 and has specialised in the cosmestics and perfume sector, where it is a market leader.
However, this business no longer fits into Jacky Maeder's strategy, which is to focus on core businesses, air and sea freight and global logistics.
